page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m4.xlarge is a burstable general-purpose instance type belonging to the ecs.t6 family. It features 4 vCPUs mapped to 2 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY cores running at 2.5 GHz, utilizing hyper-threading to provide 2 threads per core on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, translating to 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance primarily in the lower tiers. In CPU-intensive tests, the single-core stress-ng score of 1296.59 and multi-core score of 5015.63 are categorized as weak, falling into the bottom 25% of tested hardware. Similarly, the Geekbench single-core score of 983.0 and multi-core score of 2922.0 reflect limited processing capability. Memory bandwidth tests show a weak read-only large block speed of 34.73 GB/sec, though the write large block speed of 26.23 GB/sec reaches average levels. Single-threaded bzip3 decompression performance is poor, registering at 6.76 GB/sec.

Due to its burstable CPU allocation model, this instance is designed for workloads with low baseline CPU utilization that occasionally experience brief spikes in demand. The lack of local storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps represent significant tradeoffs, making it less suitable for sustained high-throughput tasks. Qualitatively, the hardware profile offers a cost-efficient option for development environments, low-traffic web servers, code repositories, and basic microservices where continuous maximum CPU performance is not required.
